source.extractionTool: pdftotext (poppler), -enc UTF-8, raw and -layout modes; pdfplumber for underlines, sub/superscripts and figure positions
source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Genuine ICSE 2025 board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library bundle 'ICSE-MainExamination2025.zip' (the bundle name gives the session as the main examination; the paper itself prints only the code 'T25 523'). Printed: Maximum Marks 80, Time allowed Two hours, 16 printed pages. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory: Question 1 has 15 MCQ/assertion-reason items under one printed total [15] (stored as GROUP_TOTAL, marks 0); Question 2 has five 5-mark sub-questions (i)-(v); (i)-(iv) are split into their parts (a)-(e), each printing only the group total [5] (stored as GROUP_TOTAL, marks 0), (v) is a single 5-mark matching item. Section B prints 'Attempt any four questions from this Section' over six 10-mark questions (3-8); all six are included, so the stored per-item marks (Section A group totals excluded) do not sum to the printed maximum of 80 (pick 4 of 6, not an OR choice, so choiceGroup is not used). Section B sub-parts are kept at the printed (i)-(v) level with their printed marks; lettered parts (a)/(b)/(c) under them carry no separate marks and stay together. The assertion-reason items in this paper print only four options ((A) true/(R) false; (A) false/(R) true; both true; both false).
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.

Given below is the diagram of a human heart. Read the information below the diagram and fill in the blanks:
The human heart pumps blood throughout the body. It is the size of a large fist. The heart is located between the lungs in the thoracic cavity. It has four chambers. The heart functions all through the lifespan of a person and is responsible for the survival of the person.
The heart is enclosed by a membrane called (a) ____________. The ventricles give rise to two large blood vessels called (b) ____________ and (c) ____________. The flaps of the cuspid valves are kept in position by (d) ____________. (e) ____________ arteries supply oxygenated blood to the walls of the heart.

A farmer cultivates a unique species of tomato plants. The two traits selected for breeding were: Colour of the fruits and height of the plants. The farmer initially crosses a homozygous tall plant bearing red fruits (TTRR) with a dwarf plant bearing yellow fruits (ttrr) and the genotype of all the offsprings of the F₁ generation was TtRr. Next, he crosses two F₁ generation plants (TtRr).
(a) Explain the phenotype of the offsprings of the F₁ generation obtained from the initial cross.
(b) Mention the phenotypic ratio of the F₂ generation offsprings.
(c) State Mendel’s Law of Independent Assortment.
